name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: A toolkit that gives AI coding assistants a persistent memory and better habits, so they stop forgetting your project's context and stop making the same mistakes every session.
buyer: An indie developer or small team lead who relies on AI coding tools daily and is frustrated re-explaining project context every single session.
business_use_cases: A solo developer sets it up once on a large legacy codebase and saves hours a week no longer having to re-onboard their AI assistant each session.
A dev tooling consultant offers 'AI workflow setup' as a paid onboarding package for teams adopting Claude Code or Cursor.
A bootcamp or course creator builds a paid tutorial teaching teams how to configure it for their specific stack.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid setup and tuning consulting for teams wiring it into their dev environment
Publish a premium course on configuring persistent AI-agent memory for teams

steal_this: This weekend, write a short guide (or record a screencast) showing how to set it up for one popular framework, and sell it as a $15 mini-course.
